#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build a cover page (title + current date) and a sample financial report body,
then merge them into report.pdf using pypdf (pure Python PDF generation)."""
import datetime
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

HELV = {
    ' ': 278, '!': 278, '"': 355, '#': 556, '$': 556, '%': 889, '&': 667,

    'v': 556, 'w': 778, 'x': 556, 'y': 556, 'z': 500, '{': 389, '|': 280,
    '}': 389, '~': 584,

PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612, 792  # US Letter


def esc(s):
    return s.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace('(', '\\(').replace(')', '\\)')


def text_width(text, font, size):
    table = HELV_BOLD if font == 'Helvetica-Bold' else HELV
    return sum(table.get(c, 500) for c in text) / 1000.0 * size


def centered_text(text, font, size, y):
    w = text_width(text, font, size)
    x = (PAGE_W - w) / 2.0
    return f'BT /{font} {size} Tf {x:.2f} {y:.2f} Td ({esc(text)}) Tj ET'


def wrap_text(text, font, size, max_width):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ''
    for word in words:
        trial = (cur + ' ' + word).strip()
        if text_width(trial, font, size) <= max_width or not cur:
            cur = trial
        else:
            lines.append(cur)
            cur = word
    if cur:
        lines.append(cur)
    return lines


def build_pdf(content_streams, out_path, page_size=(PAGE_W, PAGE_H)):
    n = len(content_streams)
    objs = []
    objs.append(b'<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>')
    kids = ' '.join(f'{3 + i} 0 R' for i in range(n))
    objs.append(f'<< /Type /Pages /Kids [{kids}] /Count {n} >>'.encode())

        res = f'<< /Font << /F1 {font1} 0 R /F2 {font2} 0 R >> >>'
        objs.append(
            f'<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R '
            f'/MediaBox [0 0 {page_size[0]} {page_size[1]}] '
            f'/Resources {res} /Contents {stream_start + i} 0 R >>'.encode()
        )

    objs.append(b'<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>')
    for cs in content_streams:
        data = cs.encode('latin-1')
        objs.append(
            f'<< /Length {len(data)} >>\nstream\n'.encode() + data + b'\nendstream'
        )

    out = bytearray(b'%PDF-1.4\n')
    offsets = []
    for i, obj in enumerate(objs, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += f'{i} 0 obj\n'.encode() + obj + b'\nendobj\n'
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += f'xref\n0 {len(objs) + 1}\n'.encode()
    out += b'0000000000 65535 f \n'
    for off in offsets:
        out += f'{off:010d} 00000 n \n'.encode()
    out += (f'trailer\n<< /Size {len(objs) + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\n'
            f'startxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n').encode()
    with open(out_path, 'wb') as fh:
        fh.write(out)


# --- 1) Cover page: title + current date ---
today = datetime.date.today().strftime('%B %d, %Y')
print('Current date:', today)

cover_lines = [
    '0.85 0.85 0.85 rg',
    '72 700 468 1.2 re f',
    '0 0 0 rg',
    centered_text('Annual Financial Report', 'Helvetica-Bold', 30, 500),
    '0 0 0 RG 1.5 w',
    '100 455 m 512 455 l S',
    centered_text(today, 'Helvetica', 16, 415),
]
cover = '\n'.join(cover_lines) + '\n'

# --- 2) Body page(s): sample financial report content ---
body_lines = []
body_lines.append(centered_text('Sample Financial Report', 'Helvetica-Bold', 20, 740))
body_lines.append('0.85 0.85 0.85 rg')
body_lines.append('72 726 468 1.2 re f')
body_lines.append('0 0 0 rg')

paragraphs = [
    'Executive Summary',
    'This document summarizes the organization\'s financial performance for '
    'the fiscal year. Revenue grew steadily across all major business lines, '
    'driven by continued demand for core services and improved operational '
    'efficiency.',
    'Financial Highlights',
    'Total revenue increased 12.4% year over year to $48.2 million. Operating '
    'expenses grew 6.1% to $31.9 million, reflecting planned investments in '
    'technology and staffing. Net income reached $9.6 million, an increase of '
    '18.9% compared with the prior year.',
    'Balance Sheet Overview',
    'Cash and equivalents ended the period at $14.7 million. Total assets stood '
    'at $87.3 million against total liabilities of $41.5 million, yielding a '
    'debt-to-equity ratio of 0.91 and a current ratio of 2.4.',
    'Outlook',
    'Management expects continued growth in the coming year, with a targeted '
    'revenue increase of 8-10% and continued margin improvement.',
]

y = 690
font = 'Helvetica'
size = 11
body_lines.append(f'BT /{font} {size} Tf 0 0 0 rg ET')
for para in paragraphs:
    if para in ('Executive Summary', 'Financial Highlights',
                'Balance Sheet Overview', 'Outlook'):
        body_lines.append(centered_text(para, 'Helvetica-Bold', 14, y))
        y -= 24
        continue
    for line in wrap_text(para, font, size, 470):
        body_lines.append(f'BT /{font} {size} Tf 72 {y:.1f} Td ({esc(line)}) Tj ET')
        y -= 16
    y -= 8
footer = ('Note: The original report.pdf was not present in the workspace, so this '
          'sample body was generated to demonstrate the cover page.')
y = max(y, 60)
for line in wrap_text(footer, 'Helvetica', 9, 470):
    body_lines.append(f'BT /Helvetica 9 Tf 0.45 0.45 0.45 rg 72 {y:.1f} Td ({esc(line)}) Tj ET')
    y -= 13
body = '\n'.join(body_lines) + '\n'

# --- 3) Write intermediate PDFs and merge into report.pdf ---
build_pdf([cover], 'cover.pdf')
build_pdf([body], 'body.pdf')

writer = PdfWriter()
for f in ('cover.pdf', 'body.pdf'):
    reader = PdfReader(f)
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)
with open('report.pdf', 'wb') as out:
    writer.write(out)
print('Wrote report.pdf')
